_comment: Tiered local model registry for the SystemOne model router (POST /v1/systemone/route). The router picks the cheapest tier sufficient for each task. Tiers with model_id=null are not routable until configured. latency_ms_p50: fill from measured runs (the shim logs per-decision latency to logs/systemone-shim.log) so routing claims carry receipts.

base.description: text-classification; no-tools; context=512 tokens; latency=tier-3 (slowest of the local GLiClass family); memory=~0.8GB; cost=highest local. Best for: nuanced or ambiguous judgments where edge is uncertain.

edge.description: text-classification; no-tools; context=512 tokens; latency=tier-1 (fastest); memory=~0.1GB; cost=cheapest. Best for: simple classification, spam/triage, routing pre-checks.

heavy.description: 35B-class local LLM (LM Studio / llama.cpp). Highest capability, highest latency; reserved for tasks the local GLiClass tiers cannot judge.
heavy.note: Not configured: set model_id to your local 35B checkpoint (e.g. your LM Studio model id) to make this tier routable. The router skips null tiers.
